conditions.description: European Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to researchers of any nationality.
Global Postdoctoral Fellowships are open to European nationals or long-term residents.
The fellowship requires international mobility of the researcher (mobility conditions as detailed in the eligibility conditions of the Work Programme part).
Applications must be made jointly by the researcher and a beneficiary established in the academic or non-academic sector.

Eligible countries are described in Annex B of the Work Programme General Annexes; other eligibility conditions are described in Annex B; admissibility conditions are described in Annex A and Annex E.
Financial and operational capacity requirements are described in Annex C of the Work Programme General Annexes.

For MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships in research areas covered by the Euratom Research and Training Programme, organisations active in nuclear research must be established in an EU Member State or a country associated to the Euratom Research and Training Programme.

Where an optional non-academic placement is included, the placement host organisation must be from the non-academic sector and established in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country (or, for Euratom-area proposals, a Euratom-associated country); it may not take place in an academic organisation or a Third Country.
